changeSet.author: petstore
changeSet.comment: The lock table behind the outbox publisher. It lives in the schema of the service; the provider is configured with the qualified name in application.yml.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE shedlock ( name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, lock_until TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, locked_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, locked_by VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT pk_shedlock PRIMARY KEY (name) );
